Stackpole]]. The audiobook was performed by [[Marc Thompson]] and was released by [[Random House Audio]] on [[September 7]], [[2021]] as part of ''[[The Essential Legends Collection]]''. It was produced and directed by [[Kevin Thomsen]], with [[Nick Martorelli]] serving as executive producer. Post-production and sound mixing was done by [[Paul Goodrich]] and [[Justin Kilpatrick]].
